## WIP checkpoint and PR promotion (#706)

### OB84 · OR46
Given: The Developer has completed a segment on wip/40-example at full SHA aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. The working tree is clean. That exact head passed ./check --no-tests and all affected case commands named in the brief; the required whole-file behavior run is current and its generated stamp is committed. All commands, results and the SHA are recorded. The PR branch feature/40-example is an ancestor. No repair or authored edit is needed.
When: You update the publication ref before the QA comparison.
Then: next_action=answer_directly; next_role=none

### OB85 · OR46
Given: A Developer segment returned partial work on wip/40-example and checkpointed it. ./check --no-tests fails because an implementation edit is unfinished. No test or scenario is faulty; no existing agent has reusable working context. A PR branch exists at the last green head.
When: You choose how to complete the segment before promotion.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=Developer

### OB86 · OR15, OR46
Given: Review round 1 is due. WIP is at aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa with current D6 evidence, but the remote PR head is bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, an ancestor of WIP. QA comparison matched WIP only. No finding is open.
When: You choose the next step before dispatching Review.
Then: next_action=answer_directly; next_role=none

### OB87 · OR15, OR46
Given: Review round 2 is due. Promotion and the matching QA comparison were recorded for aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. A fresh read shows the remote PR head has since moved to bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb and there is no D6 evidence or comparison for it. No finding is open.
When: You choose the next step before starting Review on the changed head.
Then: next_action=self_check

### OB88 · OR46, OR48
Given: WIP commit aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa passed every promotion check. A later doc-only commit bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb has only its passing pre-commit checks, with no ./check --no-tests or affected case evidence for that SHA. The PR branch is an ancestor and no behavior stamp is affected.
When: You decide what is needed before publishing the later head.
Then: next_action=self_check

### OB89 · OR15, OR34, OR46
Given: Review round 1 is due at the confirmed promoted remote PR head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, with clean exact-head D6 evidence recorded. A valid timely human skip=Test record is linked and recognized. The Pipeline log has the not-applicable QA provenance line for that exact PR head and waiver. No finding is open, and the Review brief has all required fields.
When: You start the Review round.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=Reviewer; asks_human=false

### OB90 · OR15, OR17, OR46
Given: Review is due at the confirmed promoted PR head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa with current D6 evidence. The QA comparison on that head returned exit 1, different. Its disclosed finding is class test: QA owns the faulty scenario. No owning-role resolution or new artifact exists and no reusable agent context exists.
When: You choose the next step before Review.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=QA

### OB91 · OR46
Given: An external base merge moved origin/feature/40-example. WIP has different later work; its explicit SHA promotion is rejected as non-fast-forward. Both histories must be preserved. Resolving their conflict needs an authored implementation edit and no existing agent context can be reused.
When: You choose who reconciles the remote PR head into WIP before new D6 validation.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=Developer
